assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished portrait front cover for a mathematics and programming book, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, high resolution.
Primary request: Design a beautiful, sophisticated cover for "Topological Data Analysis with Julia" by G. Vituri. This is an approachable but mathematically serious book about the shape of data, simplicial complexes, persistent homology, and Mapper, with runnable Julia examples.
Scene/backdrop: deep midnight ink-blue matte paper, subtle fine print grain.
Subject: one elegant large tilted loop made from a sparse cloud of points that gradually becomes a delicately triangulated translucent mesh. The loop has a clearly open central hole. Very fine connecting edges and a few triangle faces, with rich but restrained Julia-inspired green, purple, and brick-red accents. In the lower area, a small group of clean horizontal persistence-barcode-like strokes echoes the loop's palette. These are artistic motifs, not a plotted experimental result.
Style/medium: premium contemporary mathematical book design; precise geometric illustration, restrained luminous edges, excellent editorial typography, quiet tactile print character.
Composition/framing: flat front-cover artwork filling the canvas, no book mockup. Strong typographic hierarchy in the upper third, spacious margins, the loop prominent through the middle and lower-middle, author at bottom. Refined balance and substantial breathing room. Typography must be large and beautifully legible at thumbnail size.
Text (verbatim): "TOPOLOGICAL" on the first line, "DATA ANALYSIS" on the second line, "with Julia" on the third line; "G. Vituri" at the bottom. Render the exact spelling, capitalization, and punctuation. Use elegant warm-white serif lettering for the main title, understated complementary lettering for "with Julia" and author.
Constraints: finished usable cover; exact title and author; no extra words, equations, logos, watermarks, axes, numerical claims, decorative frame, or fake publisher. Keep the main central hole empty of triangles. Avoid neon cyberpunk, excessive glow, generic tech circuitry, stock-art styling, clutter, and tiny illegible text.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide landscape chapter-opening illustration for the online book "Topological Data Analysis with Julia", roughly 3:1 aspect ratio.
Primary request: Create a refined text-free editorial illustration of discovering a loop in data. Match a mathematical book's geometric visual identity: Julia-inspired green, muted purple, and brick red on warm ivory paper, with dark midnight ink-blue lines.
Scene/backdrop: warm ivory matte paper, very subtle fine grain, generous empty space.
Subject: three related artistic views of the same ring, arranged in a calm horizontal rhythm: a sparse irregular ring of discrete sample points; a similar ring whose nearby points are joined by fine edges and a few translucent triangles, still leaving a large central hole; a distilled elegant loop with a few short understated horizontal barcode-like strokes beside it. The central holes must remain clearly visible. Small subtle dotted continuation marks may suggest a relationship between the views. These are conceptual visual motifs, not an experimental plot or a formal explanation.
Style/medium: sophisticated scientific editorial illustration, delicate geometrical linework and translucent ink-like triangle fills, restrained tactile print texture, crisp points. Quiet, balanced, and inviting.
Composition/framing: horizontal artwork, three motifs of comparable visual size, all well inside the canvas with generous margins and comfortable spacing. Moderate complexity, legible at normal web page width. No text anywhere.
Constraints: no captions, letters, numbers, equations, axes, chart legends, logos, watermarks, computers, people, or ornamental border. No triangles filling the central holes. Avoid bright neon, heavy gradients, cartoon styling, dense tangled networks, or a glossy 3D render.
